concerns.text: Missing tasks for FR-003 (saving model artifacts) and FR-004 (computing metrics on held-out test set). T024 (save models) and T025 (compute/save metrics) are marked incomplete/missing, yet FR-003 requires saving 'models/final_rf.pkl' and FR-004 requires computing R²/RMSE/MAE on the test set. T034 (generate report) depends on these missing outputs.

Missing tasks for Plan Phase 0 (Data Availability Check) and foundational infrastructure. T001 (project structure) and T007 (data directory/checksum logic) are marked incomplete, yet the Plan explicitly requires 'Phase 0: Data Availability Check' and checksumming raw data per Constitution Principle III. Without T007, the 'Data Hygiene' requirement is unmet.

Task T031 implements baseline shift as 'predicted_E_solute - measured_E_pure_host', but FR-006 and Plan FR/SC Mapping define the baseline strictly as 'E_solute_measured - E_pure_host_measured' (Experimental Ground Truth). The task uses a model prediction where the spec requires measured experimental ground truth for the solute, creating a coverage gap for the correct FR-006 implementation.

Task T038 (Performance optimization) is marked incomplete with no benchmark evidence, yet SC-004 and Plan require the pipeline to complete within 6 hours and models within 15 minutes. While not a missing FR, the lack of a completed task to verify this constraint leaves the success criterion unverified in the task plan.

Task T039 (edge case tests) is incomplete, leaving the 'Single-host-metal' and 'Missing atomic data' edge cases defined in spec.md without explicit unit test coverage. While T015 and T014 handle the logic, the specific test coverage for these edge cases is missing from the task list.
